requirement: Undo is offered after a turn whose apply created a row (page, post, first postmeta)

oracle.ref: PR #1259 (fix); fix evidence: Reproduced 4/4 on a WordPress dev site: create a page, write a post, set the first browser-tab title and meta description each answered 'Tracy has no record of some page edits it made'.
oracle.invariant: That test reports ok: a site_write recorded as content.create pairs with its content.update audit row, recovers the apply id and the turn's undo state is available (pre-fix: no pair, NOT_RECORDED/content).
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: a create-recorded write pairs with its content.update audit row
tests: a create-recorded write pairs with its content.update audit row
